advice: I abstain. The supplied source shows the transpose helper writes a full physical transpose, but it does not show a legal instruction sequence to transpose a small A tile and feed it directly to the existing MOPA loop. A tile-sized temporary would still need an evidenced layout and load mapping. I cannot specify those from the supplied evidence without inventing instructions or an implementation.
risks: A per-column-panel transpose would repeat A conversion 16 times; for each 32-row half, that reads and converts the same A tile once for each of 16 panels. It also adds tile stores and loads, so it may not reduce total data movement. The prior TB result includes a full timed A transpose, but it does not measure tile fusion or isolate any cause. Any future proposal needs a legal tile-to-MOPA mapping, exact conversion and movement counts, and K-order preservation before implementation or measurement.
